content_en.prompt: Raju takes 2 lunch boxes to school daily (snack + lunch) and has only 30 minutes to prepare both. Prep times: Rice 15min, Poha 20min, Sandwich 15min, Roti+Vegetable 20min, Paratha 20min, Fruit Bhel 10min.
content_en.question: Which one of the following statements is false?

options.text: If Raju packs Roti+Vegetable for lunch, he cannot pack a Sandwich for snack
If Raju packs Paratha for lunch, he can only pack Fruit Bhel for snack
If Raju packs Rice for lunch, he can pack Poha for snack
If Raju packs Rice for lunch, he can pack either Sandwich or Fruit Bhel for snack

content_en.explanation: Rice (15min) + Poha (20min) = 35 minutes, which exceeds the 30-minute limit — so statement C is false. All other statement combinations take 30 minutes or less, so they're true.
content_en.ct_explanation: Constraints reduce the flexibility of a situation or limit how a problem can be solved. In complex tasks constraints combine via conjunction (both must hold), disjunction (at least one holds) or negation (opposite of the condition). Here the constraint is a 30-minute total prep-time limit; to find the false statement, find the combination exceeding 30 minutes.

content_zh.prompt: Raju每天要帶2個便當盒去學校（點心時間一個、午餐時間一個），只有30分鐘可以準備兩個便當。各餐點準備時間：飯15分鐘、Poha(印度炒扁米)20分鐘、三明治15分鐘、烤餅配蔬菜20分鐘、Paratha烤餅20分鐘、水果沙拉10分鐘。
content_zh.question: 下面哪一句敘述是「錯的」？

options.text: 如果Raju午餐帶烤餅配蔬菜，點心就不能帶三明治
如果Raju午餐帶Paratha烤餅，點心就只能帶水果沙拉
如果Raju午餐帶飯，點心可以帶Poha
如果Raju午餐帶飯，點心可以帶三明治或水果沙拉

content_zh.explanation: 飯(15分鐘)+Poha(20分鐘)＝35分鐘，超過30分鐘的限制，所以C是錯的敘述。其他選項的組合都在30分鐘以內，所以都是對的。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 限制條件會降低一個情境的彈性，或是限縮問題的解法範圍。在比較複雜的任務裡，限制條件會用「且」（兩者都要成立）、「或」（至少一個成立）、「非」（條件的反面）組合起來。這一題的限制條件是「準備時間總共不超過30分鐘」；要找出錯的敘述，只要找出總時間超過30分鐘的組合就行了。
